# Glyph reference

Each name below links to its definitions and examples. Examples show an equivalent APL value after `⍝`. A monad takes one argument; a dyad takes two. Operators take functions or arrays and derive functions. Notes give glyph-specific differences from Dyalog APL.

## Functions

| Glyph | Monad | Dyad | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `+` [Add](glyphs/add.qmd) | Conjugate | Add | Character offsets as BQN: `'a'+3` is `'d'` |
| `-` [Dash](glyphs/dash.qmd) | Negate | Subtract | Character difference as BQN: `'d'-'a'` is `3x` |
| `×` [Mul](glyphs/mul.qmd) | Direction | Multiply | |
| `÷` [Div](glyphs/div.qmd) | Reciprocal | Divide | Exact rationals as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3` |
| `⌊` [Floor](glyphs/floor.qmd) | Floor | Minimum | `⌊/⍬` is `∞` |
| `⌈` [Ceiling](glyphs/ceiling.qmd) | Ceiling | Maximum | `⌈/⍬` is `¯∞` |
| `\|` [Stile](glyphs/stile.qmd) | Magnitude | Residue | |
| `*` [Star](glyphs/star.qmd) | Exponential | Exponent | |
| `⍟` [Log](glyphs/log.qmd) | Natural log | Logarithm | |
| `○` [Circle](glyphs/circle.qmd) | Unit circle | Circular functions | Monad is `*0j1×Y`, a unit-circle point. Pi times is `π` |
| `π` [Pi](glyphs/pi.qmd) | Pi times | Pi fraction | Monad takes over Pi times from `○`. `XπY` is Xπ÷Y |
| `√` [Root](glyphs/root.qmd) | Square root | Nth root | As BQN's `√`, with complex results: `√¯4` is `0j2` |
| `!` [Factorial](glyphs/factorial.qmd) | Factorial | Binomial | |
| `ℙ` [Prime](glyphs/prime.qmd) | Nth prime, counting from 0 | Prime operations | As J's `p:`, with the same codes |
| `⨸` [Factor](glyphs/factor.qmd) | Prime factors | Exponents / factor table | As J's `q:`, with `∞` and `¯∞` for J's `_` and `__` |
| `⊛` [Polynomial](glyphs/polynomial.qmd) | Roots / coefficients | Evaluate | As J's `p.`: coefficients are constant-first |
| `?` [Question](glyphs/question.qmd) | Roll | Deal | |
| `∨` [Or](glyphs/or.qmd) | Real / imaginary parts | OR / GCD | Monad as J's `+.` |
| `∧` [And](glyphs/and.qmd) | Magnitude / angle | AND / LCM | Monad as J's `*.` |
| `⍲` [Nand](glyphs/nand.qmd) | Square | NAND | Monad as J's `*:` |
| `⍱` [Nor](glyphs/nor.qmd) | Double | NOR | Monad as J's `+:` |
| `~` [Tilde](glyphs/tilde.qmd) | NOT | Without | |
| `=` [Equal](glyphs/equal.qmd) | Self-classify | Equal | Monad as J: one mask row per distinct major cell |
| `≠` [Not equal](glyphs/not-equal.qmd) | Unique mask | Not equal | |
| `<` [Less](glyphs/less.qmd) | — | Less | |
| `≤` [Less or equal](glyphs/less-or-equal.qmd) | Decrement | Less or equal | Monad as J's `<:` |
| `>` [Greater](glyphs/greater.qmd) | — | Greater | |
| `≥` [Greater or equal](glyphs/greater-or-equal.qmd) | Increment | Greater or equal | Monad as J's `>:` |
| `≡` [Match](glyphs/match.qmd) | Depth | Match | |
| `≢` [Tally](glyphs/tally.qmd) | Tally | Not match | |
| `⍴` [Rho](glyphs/rho.qmd) | Shape | Reshape | `⍬⍴Y` gives a rank-0 array: `⍬⍴1 2` is `⊂1` |
| `,` [Comma](glyphs/comma.qmd) | Ravel | Catenate | |
| `⍪` [Table](glyphs/table.qmd) | Table | Catenate first | |
| `⌽` [Reverse](glyphs/reverse.qmd) | Reverse last | Rotate last | |
| `⊖` [Reverse first](glyphs/reverse-first.qmd) | Reverse first | Rotate first | |
| `⍉` [Transpose](glyphs/transpose.qmd) | Transpose | Reorder / diagonal axes | |
| `↑` [Take](glyphs/take.qmd) | First | Take | Monad as Dyalog `⎕ML≥2`, but takes a major cell: `↑2 3⍴⍳6` is `0 1 2` |
| `↓` [Drop](glyphs/drop.qmd) | Split | Drop | |
| `↕` [Windows](glyphs/windows.qmd) | — | Leading-axis windows | As BQN's `↕`, plus movements and padding (negative sizes) as in `⌺`. Replaces windowed reduce: `+/2↕1 2 3 4` is `3 5 7` |
| `⊂` [Enclose](glyphs/enclose.qmd) | Enclose | Partitioned enclose | Encloses atoms too, as BQN: `(⊂3)≡3` is `0x` |
| `⊆` [Nest](glyphs/nest.qmd) | Nest | Partition | |
| `⊃` [Mix](glyphs/mix.qmd) | Mix | Pick | Monad as Dyalog `⎕ML≥2`. Pick takes cells: `1⊃2 3⍴⍳6` is `3 4 5`. A string picks by [key](keyed.qmd) |
| `⌷` [Squad](glyphs/squad.qmd) | Identity | Index | Negative positions count from the end. `∞` takes a whole axis and `¯∞` reverses it |
| `⍳` [Iota](glyphs/iota.qmd) | Index generator | Index of | `⍳⍠A Y` returns axis selectors. A negative length counts down, as J: `⍳¯3` is `2 1 0` |
| `⍸` [Where](glyphs/where.qmd) | Where | Interval index | Dyad counts the boundaries at or below each value, as BQN's `⍋`: `1 3 5⍸0 3 9` is `0 2 3` |
| `∊` [Member](glyphs/member.qmd) | Enlist | Membership | |
| `∪` [Union](glyphs/union.qmd) | Unique | Union | |
| `∩` [Intersection](glyphs/intersection.qmd) | — | Intersection | |
| `⍷` [Find](glyphs/find.qmd) | — | Find | |
| `⍋` [Grade up](glyphs/grade-up.qmd) | Grade up | Grade with collation | |
| `⍒` [Grade down](glyphs/grade-down.qmd) | Grade down | Grade with collation | |
| `/` [Slash](glyphs/slash.qmd) | — | Replicate last | |
| `⌿` [Slash bar](glyphs/slash-bar.qmd) | — | Replicate first | |
| `\` [Backslash](glyphs/backslash.qmd) | — | Expand last | |
| `⍀` [Backslash bar](glyphs/backslash-bar.qmd) | — | Expand first | |
| `⊤` [Encode](glyphs/encode.qmd) | Binary encode | Encode | Monad as J's `#:`, but digits run along the first axis |
| `⊥` [Decode](glyphs/decode.qmd) | Binary decode | Decode | Monad as J's `#.`, but digits run along the first axis |
| `⌹` [Domino](glyphs/domino.qmd) | Matrix inverse | Matrix divide | |
| `⊣` [Left](glyphs/left.qmd) | Identity | Left | |
| `⊢` [Right](glyphs/right.qmd) | Identity | Right | |
| `⍎` [Execute](glyphs/execute.qmd) | Execute | Keyed lookup: `X⍎Y` is `Y⊃X` | Dyad runs no code. Dyalog executes `Y` in namespace `X` |
| `⍕` [Format](glyphs/format.qmd) | Format | Format by specification | |

## Operators

`f`, `g` are functions; `a`, `n`, `r` are arrays or numbers.

| Glyph | Form | Meaning | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` [Slash](glyphs/slash.qmd) | `f/` | Reduce / seeded reduce last | Seed as BQN's `´`: `10 -/1 2 3` is `¯8`. For windows use `↕` |
| `⌿` [Slash bar](glyphs/slash-bar.qmd) | `f⌿` | Reduce / seeded reduce first | Seed and windows as `/` |
| `\` [Backslash](glyphs/backslash.qmd) | `f\` | Scan / seeded scan last | Accumulates left to right as BQN's Scan: `-\1 2 3` is `1 ¯1 ¯4` |
| `⍀` [Backslash bar](glyphs/backslash-bar.qmd) | `f⍀` | Scan / seeded scan first | Left to right as `\` |
| `¨` [Each](glyphs/each.qmd) | `f¨` | Each | |
| `⍨` [Commute](glyphs/commute.qmd) | `f⍨`, `a⍨` | Self / commute / constant | |
| `⊸` [Before](glyphs/before.qmd) | `f⊸g`, `a⊸f` | Before / bind left | As BQN's `⊸` |
| `⟜` [After](glyphs/after.qmd) | `f⟜g`, `f⟜a` | After / bind right | As BQN's `⟜` |
| `⍤` [Rank](glyphs/rank.qmd) | `f⍤g`, `f⍤r` | Atop / rank | |
| `⍠` [Axis](glyphs/axis.qmd) | `f⍠A` | Apply along axes | Axes are numbers or names, in place of Dyalog's `f[A]` |
| `⍥` [Over](glyphs/over.qmd) | `f⍥g` | Over | |
| `.` [Dot](glyphs/dot.qmd) | `f.g` | Inner product | Outer product is `g⌝`. After an array, `T.name` is `"name"⊃T`, and `x.(I)` is `(I)⌷x` |
| `⌝` [Outer product](glyphs/outer-product.qmd) | `g⌝` | Outer product | As BQN's `⌜`; `∘.g` is a `SYNTAX` error |
| `⌸` [Key](glyphs/key.qmd) | `f⌸` | Key | |
| `⍣` [Power](glyphs/power.qmd) | `f⍣n`, `f⍣∞`, `f⍣g`, `f⍣[g;]` | Iterate / invert / fixed point / repeat until / history until | A list of counts gives the result for each count, as J's `^:` and BQN's `⍟`: `(1+⍣3 ¯2 0 3)10` is `13 8 10 13` |
| `⇄` [Inverse pair](glyphs/inverse-pair.qmd) | `f⇄g` | Attach an explicit inverse | As J's `:.` |
| `⌾` [Under](glyphs/under.qmd) | `f⌾g` | Transform, apply, inverse-transform | As J's `&.` |
| `∂` [Derivative](glyphs/derivative.qmd) | `f∂` | Gradient / vector–Jacobian product | |
| `◶` [Agenda](glyphs/agenda.qmd) | `selector◶cases` | Select and call one function | As BQN's `◶` |
| `@` [At](glyphs/at.qmd) | `f@a`, `a@g` | Functional amend | |
| `⌺` [Stencil](glyphs/stencil.qmd) | `f⌺a` | Stencil | |

## Syntax and literals

| Form | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `←` [Assign](glyphs/assign.qmd) | Assignment, including modified and selective forms |
| `→` [Pipe](glyphs/pipe.qmd) | Left-to-right function application |
| `(…)` [Parentheses](glyphs/parentheses.qmd) | Grouping |
| `[…]` [Brackets](glyphs/brackets.qmd) | Lists and arrays: `[a b c]`, `[a;b c]`, `[1 2 ⋄ 3 4]`. One item only groups: `[x]` is `x`, and `[x;]` is a one-item list |
| `{…}` [Braces](glyphs/braces.qmd) | Defined function or operator |
| `⍺` [Alpha](glyphs/alpha.qmd), `⍵` [Omega](glyphs/omega.qmd) | Left / right argument |
| `⍶` [Alpha underbar](glyphs/alpha-underbar.qmd), `⍹` [Omega underbar](glyphs/omega-underbar.qmd) | Left / right operand |
| `∇` [Del](glyphs/del.qmd), `⍢` [Del diaeresis](glyphs/del-diaeresis.qmd) | Function / operator self-reference |
| `:` [Colon](glyphs/colon.qmd), `::` [Error guard](glyphs/error-guard.qmd) | Unkey / key axes; Boolean guard / error guard inside dfns |
| `⋄` [Diamond](glyphs/diamond.qmd) | Separates statements, and rows inside brackets |
| `⍝` [Comment](glyphs/comment.qmd) | Comment |
| `⎕←` [Quad](glyphs/quad.qmd) | Explicit output |
| `•` [Bullet](glyphs/bullet.qmd) | [System name](#system-names) prefix |
| `⍬` [Zilde](glyphs/zilde.qmd) | Empty numeric vector |
| `'…'` `"…"` [Quote](glyphs/quote.qmd) | Character and string literals |
| `¯` [Overbar](glyphs/overbar.qmd) | Negative literal sign |
| `∞` [Infinity](glyphs/infinity.qmd) | Real infinity |

Numeric notation `x`, `r`, `j`, `E`: see [numbers](rules.qmd#numbers).

## System names

Names are case-insensitive. `•a` and `•d` are constant arrays; the other names are functions, usable with operators and composition.

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `•a` [Alphabet](glyphs/alphabet.qmd) | Uppercase Latin alphabet |
| `•d` [Digits](glyphs/digits.qmd) | Decimal digits |
| `•c` [Case](glyphs/case.qmd) | Unicode case conversion |
| `•csv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | CSV text → keyed column vectors |
| `•tocsv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | Keyed column vectors → CSV text |
| `•r` [Regex](regex.ipynb) | Compiled search, captures and replacement |
| `•normal`, `•binomial`, … [Distributions](distributions.ipynb) | Sampling, density, CDF and quantiles; 17 families |
| `•json` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | JSON text → arrays and keyed vectors |
| `•tojson` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | Arrays and keyed vectors → JSON text |
| `•vfi` [Numeric input](data.ipynb#numeric-input) | Parse numeric fields with a validity mask |
| `•nget` [Read](data.ipynb#files) | Read UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•nput` [Write](data.ipynb#files) | Write UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•element`, `•xml`, `•svg` [XML and SVG](xml.ipynb) | Build, serialize and display element trees |
| `•mime` [Rich display](xml.ipynb#rich-display) | The MIME bundle that display uses |
| `•plot` [Plots](plot.ipynb) | Charts from vectors, matrices and tables |
| `•ucs` [Unicode](glyphs/unicode.qmd) | Unicode code points / encodings |
| `•load` [Load](glyphs/load.qmd) | Evaluate an APL source file |
| `•signal` [Signal](glyphs/error-guard.qmd#signal) | Raise an ordinary APL error |
| `•nc` [Name class](introspection.ipynb) | Classify visible names |
| `•nl` [Name list](introspection.ipynb) | List names by class and prefix |
| `•src` [Source](introspection.ipynb) | Function/operator source |
| `•ex` [Expunge](introspection.ipynb) | Erase bindings |

Index origin: 0. Negative positions and axes count from the end. Comparison tolerance: `1E¯14`.

## Language-wide differences from Dyalog APL

- [Lists](glyphs/brackets.qmd): brackets write lists, `[a b c]`, and a list of literals can leave them out, `1 2 3`. Brackets round one item only group it, so `[x]` is `x`. Nothing else strands, so arrays next to each other don't form a list.
- [Units](rules.qmd): outside brackets, a space separates units, and each unit is evaluated first: `a+b × c+d` is `(a+b)×(c+d)`. A unit that ends in a function is a left section: `2×`.
- [Array application](glyphs/squad.qmd): an array next to an argument selects from it, as K does: `v 0` is the first item of `v`.
- [Atoms](rules.qmd#arrays-nesting-and-fill): numbers, characters and functions are atoms, distinct from scalars, as BQN. Enclosing always adds a layer: `(⊂3)≡3` is `0x`.
- [Numbers](rules.qmd#numbers): bare numbers are approximate. `x` and `r` mark exact integers and rationals, as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3`. Predicates, positions, tally and shape are exact.
- [Agreement](rules.qmd#agreement-and-pervasion): scalar functions, Each and Rank align leading axes, and unit dimensions expand: `(2 3⍴⍳6)+10 20` is `[10 11 12 ⋄ 23 24 25]`.
- [System names](#system-names): written `•name`, as BQN, not `⎕NAME`. Most Dyalog system functions and variables are not included.
- [Axis keys](keyed.qmd) name data. `K:Y` evaluates its keys. `T.a` is `"a"⊃T`, and `X⍎Y` is `Y⊃X`.
